name: FIRST DAY
source:
When Robin, a fresh college graduate opposed to change, gets snatched up by a big company as a new hire... They learn more about themself, their coworkers, and this company where not everything is quite right.

[from [url=https://abrookst.itch.io/first-day]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
抗拒改变的应届大学毕业生罗宾，一毕业便被一家大型企业招入麾下……作为职场新人，罗宾将进一步认识自我、熟悉身边的同事，并逐步看清这家处处透着古怪的公司。

[摘自[url=https://abrookst.itch.io/first-day]itch.io[/url]]
